summary: Listed on tnlandforms.us as a Pike County tower at 855 ft; no source we read describes its history or whether it stands.

evidence.supports: tower named pike in Pike County at 855 ft, with BLL and gfc reference numbers

notes_for_editor: Single source: one row in the tnlandforms.us list. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Georgia lists. A Wikimedia Commons photo titled 'Abandoned Tower, Concord Rd, Pike County' (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abandoned_Tower,_Concord_Rd,_Pike_County.JPG, taken 15 March 2014) has its viewpoint at about 33.157, -84.462, which is close to the tnlandforms Hollinville entry (GA110, 33.156, -84.462) and about 20 km from this record's point. Do not use that photo for this tower without checking. Two web searches and several reads found no history, staffing or status. Story is 58 words, well under the 120 guideline, because the evidence is one list row.
